name: Maceo
summary: Small TikTok content creator (@maceo1521) who came in for a TikTok account fix — reach/shadow-ban removal and restoration of removed videos. He handed over account login access, negotiated the price down from a quoted $1500 (after an initial ~$200 expectation) to $750 and finally $650, then paid after Zelle and Venmo both failed by transferring from savings and sending via Apple Pay. The first fix went through, but his reach was limited again on 2026-09-11 and the issue is still open as of 2026-09-12 — he was told support would be online shortly. He's polite and patient but checks in frequently for status updates, and also asked for guidance on avoiding future restrictions.
key_facts: Originally expected to pay 'in the hundreds'; quoted $1500, negotiated to a $750 option, final agreed price $650
Asked that at least 10 of 25 removed/affected videos be restored to recover reach
Shared TikTok login credentials and a 2FA code (832311) to grant access
Zelle routing number and Venmo both failed; paid via Apple Pay
Asked to split payment half now / half on Friday payday, but paid in full by moving money from savings
Account still shows branded-content restriction until Dec 8
Reach limited again on 2026-09-11 — second fix still pending as of 2026-09-12, waiting on support window
Repeatedly asked for tips on how to avoid getting restricted/banned again — good upsell/retainer opening
Self-identifies as a small creator and price-sensitive; responsive and pays, but needs proactive ETA updates
